subject: pol-con
title: (R)POL.CON.------TR.
description: Diagram in MID-W-7, on the page where Braxton describes the AACM as 'a non-profit collective organization, chartered by the State of Illinois, formed solely for the purpose of creating a more meaningful environment for both the creative musician and the community.' (R)POL-CON (the reality of political consciousness) is crossed with TR (transformation). The structural pairing is direct: real political consciousness is what crosses with transformation — meaning Braxton's claim is that the midwest movement's transformation-grade work required actual political consciousness, not just political activity. C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) → POL-CON; C-FO-ACT → DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) → INFO-CON (information convergence) and DYM-F → TR (the crossing). RT-OP (reality options) → POL-CON, and RT-OP → INTR (interpretation) → TH-AF-ALGN (thrust affinity alignment). Structural argument: real political consciousness is fed by *both* composite focused activism *and* reality options — meaning it requires both the active-doing (the AACM organizing concerts, music school, free programs) *and* the option-spread that the midwest's slower environment provided. Transformation arrives via dynamic functionalism (which is itself produced by composite focused activism, so transformation has a direct line back to activism). The reality-options → interpretation → thrust-affinity-alignment sub-chain runs in parallel, producing alignment as a separate constituting layer. The diagram thus diagrams what made the AACM transformation-capable: *both* sustained activism *and* preserved option spread, with neither alone being sufficient.
